name: @openclaw-agent-mesh/tmux-bridge
description: Agnostic tmux bridge for CLI-to-CLI agent intercommunication (Codex, Claude Code, and others).

scripts.build: echo 'tmux-bridge: shell-only package, no build step'
scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.mjs && scripts/socket-isolation-test.sh && scripts/smoke-test.sh && scripts/agent-send-readiness-test.sh && python3 scripts/idle-expiry-test.py && scripts/launch-options-test.sh && scripts/mesh-cli-smoke.sh && scripts/session-writer-test.sh && scripts/session-watch-test.sh && scripts/session-link-test.sh && scripts/desktop-session-link-test.sh
scripts.postinstall: chmod +x bin/*.sh bin/*.py bin/*.mjs scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null || true
